subject: maths
topic_title: Mind the Mistake, Mend the Mistake
content:
The following are some equations along with the steps used to solve
them to find the value of the letter−number. Go through each solution
and decide whether the steps are correct. If there is a mistake, describe
the mistake, correct it and solve the equation.
4x + 6 = 10
4x = 10 + 6
4x = 16
x = 4
7 – 8z = 5
8z = 7 – 5
8z = 2
z = 4
2v – 4 = 6
v – 4 = 6 – 2
v – 4 = 4
v = 8
5z + 2 = 3z – 4
5z + 3z = – 4 + 2
8z = – 2
z = – 2
15w – 4w = 26
15w = 26 + 4w
15w = 30
w = 2
3x + 1 = – 12
x + 1 = – 12
x + 1 = – 4
x = – 5
Ganita Prakash | Grade 7 | Part-II
7.4 A Pinch of History
4 (4q + 2) = 50
4 (4q) = 50 – 2
16q = 48
q = 3
– 2 (3 – 4x) = 14
–6v – 8x = 14
– 8x = 14 + 6
– 8x = 20
x = – 20
3 (7y + 4) = 9 + 5y
7y + 4 = 9
3 + 5y
7y + 4 = 3 + 5y
7y – 5y + 4 = 3
2y = 4 – 3
y = 1
